blockDecoration: decorateBlock adds .block + data-block-name, wraps in div.<name>-wrapper, section gains .<name>-container; scope block CSS under .<name>
buttonizationNotes:
scripts.js decorateButtons: only p > a[href] whose

text equals the link text AND is wrapped in and/or ; bare links stay links; links whose text is their own URL stay links; a link containing stays a link
fragmentNotes: blocks/fragment/fragment.js fetches <path>.plain.html into main.innerHTML, rebases img src / source srcset, runs decorateMain + loadSections; head.html CSP sets require-trusted-types-for 'script' and scripts.js installs a default Trusted Types policy that passes innerHTML strings through and strips <script> only on createContextualFragment / document.write sinks
sectionDecoration: decorateSections wraps default content in div.default-content-wrapper, folds section-metadata rows into section classes / data-*; sections start display:none until loadSection
iconDecoration: decorateIcons: span.icon.icon- -> .svg>; place SVGs under /icons/

chrome.loadOrder: header in loadLazy before main sections; footer after

fonts: loadFonts loads /styles/fonts.css after LCP (eager when innerWidth >= 900 or session flag); never in head.html
delayed: loadDelayed imports scripts/consent-check.js (consent declined by default; consented.js only on ?consent=accept)
existingBlocksNote: cards / columns / hero are the stock Block Collection copies; header / footer / styles are the stock boilerplate and are REPLACED by the foundation unit; widget + consent-check are project additions, keep them
